scope: Recorded resources for all five HLA and all 25 joint transfer cells on original training rows; development assessment only.
accounting_scope: Read-only aggregation of successful recorded local execution; no new fits, cloud jobs, outcome inspection or benchmark.

prior_resource_snapshot.interpretation: The earlier timing-only transfer snapshot remains unchanged; this separate file closes the completed transfer fitting scope without recharging shared extraction.

fitting_operational_wall_interval.definition: First timing controller start through successful remaining-controller exit; includes timing authorization/review gap and orchestration, excludes subsequent reporting.

additional_modal.definition: Transfer fitting and reporting execute locally; shared cache extraction and earlier sequence cloud charges remain in the prior resource snapshot and are not allocated again.

process_absence_verification.method: Parent-reported process listing returned header only, exit code 1.
process_absence_verification.attribution: Trusted root task message; no separate process check performed by the closeout author.

reporting.evidence: Successful report wrapper exit receipt and verified report completion marker; no numerical results inspected.

output_hash_verification_by_parent.attribution: Trusted root task message; root independently verified the report completion hash and all 19 output files. Closeout author verified the completion-marker digest only and did not inspect outcomes.

limitations: Member fit_seconds are elapsed software timers on local CPU, not measured process CPU utilization or core-seconds.
Summed member elapsed time, summed child-process wall time and controller wall spans overlap and must not be added together.
Child finish timestamps are controller-observed and include polling; subprocess wall spans include imports, validation, cache loading and orchestration beyond fit timers.
Configured numerical thread counts and recorded process concurrency do not establish actual processor utilization.
No new cost estimate, provider invoice, arm-specific inference charge, new-input latency benchmark or hardware-efficiency claim is inferred.
Report wrapper elapsed time is separately recorded and is not part of member fit timers or completed fitting wall spans; timestamp interval and recorded timer differ slightly.
